name: ac1-westwood
why: Smallest real production route. Generic sentinel, Food, and a '>' in a description exercising the asymmetric $\Rightarrow$ escape.

name: ac12-gunks-and-roses
why: Richest instruction mix: Summit x3 (climb glyph), Danger x3 + Food/Water (colored rows), and three UNMAPPED types -- Climb, Uturn, Valley -- exercising the passthrough branch at ridewithgps.py:294.

name: ac2-ridgewood
why: Slight Left/Slight Right volume; U+200B zero-width spaces in RWGPS's 'Philips Pkwy/<ZWSP>Van Riper' street-name joins.

name: calculus-block
why: LaTeX escaping torture test -- #, backslash, _, {, } all present in genuine descriptions. Tiny, stays in the fast tier.
